hero.title: Every PDF Tool.
hero.subtitle: Merge, split, compress, sign, OCR and more — all 16 tools run entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine multiple PDFs into one. Drag to reorder before merging.

split.title: Split PDF
split.description: Split by page ranges, every N pages, or extract individual pages.

organize.title: Organize Pages
organize.description: Reorder, delete, or add blank pages. Extract selections.

rotate.title: Rotate PDF
rotate.description: Rotate individual or all pages 90°, 180°, or 270°.

crop.title: Crop PDF
crop.description: Set crop margins to trim visible area on any page range.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Reduce file size with High / Medium / Low quality modes.

imageToPdf.title: Image → PDF
imageToPdf.description: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP images into a single PDF document.

pdfToImage.title: PDF → Image
pdfToImage.description: Export each page as PNG or JPG at 72, 150, or 300 DPI.

ocr.title: OCR — Extract Text
ocr.description: AI-powered text recognition from scanned pages. 10+ languages.

protect.title: Protect PDF
protect.description: Add open & owner passwords with AES encryption.

unlock.title: Unlock PDF
unlock.description: Remove password protection. Enter current password to unlock.

repair.title: Repair PDF
repair.description: Recover pages from corrupted or damaged PDF files.

watermark.title: Watermark PDF
watermark.description: Stamp text watermarks with custom font, opacity, and angle.

annotate.title: Annotate PDF
annotate.description: Add text boxes, shapes, highlights. Undo/redo stack.

sign.title: Sign PDF
sign.description: Draw, type, or upload your signature and place it on any page.

pageNumbers.title: Add Page Numbers
pageNumbers.description: Stamp page numbers with full control over position and style.

uploader.sublabel: or click to browse — up to 500 MB each
uploader.dropDamagedSub: Any PDF — even badly corrupted ones

errors.corrupted: This PDF appears to be corrupted or damaged. Try using the Repair tool.
errors.memory: Not enough memory to process this file. Try closing other tabs or splitting the file.
errors.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Use the Unlock tool first.
errors.wrongPassword: Wrong password or file is not encrypted.
errors.invalidRange: The specified page range is invalid.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.addAtLeast2: Add at least 2 PDF files to merge.

footer.highlight: All processing happens in your browser.
footer.extras: No uploads. No tracking. No sign-up.
footer.poweredBy: Powered by pdf-lib · pdfjs-dist · Tesseract.js · React 18

privacy.title: Your Privacy, Guaranteed
privacy.body: Every PDF operation runs in a Web Worker inside your browser using WebAssembly. No file ever leaves your device. No analytics, no tracking, no third-party services. Open-source and free forever.

merge.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one. Drag to reorder before merging.

split.description: Split by page ranges, every N pages, or extract individual pages.
split.individualNote: Each page will be saved as a separate PDF, downloaded as a ZIP.

compress.description: Reduce PDF file size while preserving quality.

protect.description: Add a password to your PDF to restrict access.

unlock.description: Remove password protection from a PDF file.

watermark.description: Add a text watermark to every page of your PDF.

rotate.description: Rotate individual pages or all pages at once.

organize.description: Reorder, delete, or extract pages from your PDF.

imageToPdf.description: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP images into a PDF document.

pdfToImage.description: Export each PDF page as a PNG or JPG image.

annotate.description: Add text, shapes, and highlights to your PDF.

sign.description: Draw, type, or upload your signature and place it on any page.

ocr.description: Use AI-powered OCR to extract text from scanned PDF pages.
ocr.warning: OCR may take 10–60 seconds per page. The Tesseract model loads on first use (~20 MB).

pageNumbers.description: Stamp page numbers onto every page with full control over position, style, and numbering.

crop.description: Set crop margins to trim page content. The crop box is embedded in the PDF.

repair.description: Attempt to recover pages from a corrupted or damaged PDF file.
repair.howBody: The repair tool uses pdf-lib to reload the PDF with relaxed parsing rules and copies each page individually into a new clean document. Pages that cannot be parsed are replaced with a placeholder.
